meta.expect: still today; does not play a later meeting

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I'm Owen's mother. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why did my son find out about a zero from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class?
Don't thank me yet. Who decided to enter that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
[One week later. Owen has done the rewrite and got 78.]
It's still today, Hale, and I haven't agreed to any rewrite. You haven't answered me: who entered the zero, and was Owen heard first?
So, now that the rewrite is done, are you satisfied?
Satisfied with what, Hale? No rewrite has happened, and the zero is still in the gradebook. Withdraw it, and tell me why my son was never called in before it went on.
[The principal walks in and sits down.]
Nobody has walked in, Hale. If I want the principal, I'll go upstairs and ask for the principal myself. Right now I'm still waiting for you to withdraw the zero.
